harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) as systemd services on static bootstrap config, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380. Verified cross-node read-after-write consistency, verified the cluster kept serving reads/writes with node3 stopped (2/3 quorum) and that node3 caught up fully after rejoining. Completed the mandatory sequential-restart evidence protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service/data state, rebooted each node one at a time via 'sudo reboot', confirmed each reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until reachable again, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed etcd rejoined with full 3/3 health and matching raft applied index, with prior keys still present, before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes: CentOS Stream 10, x86_64, sudo/internet available
Downloaded and installed etcd v3.5.17 (etcd/etcdctl/etcdutl) to /usr/local/bin on all nodes
Created etcd system user and /var/lib/etcd data dir on all nodes
Opened firewalld ports 2379/2380 (permanent+reload) on all nodes
Deployed systemd unit files (static 3-node initial-cluster bootstrap) to all nodes via base64
Started and enabled etcd on all 3 nodes simultaneously to bootstrap the cluster
Verified 3-member cluster: member list, endpoint health, endpoint status all healthy, node1 initial leader
Wrote 'benchkey' from node1, read it back successfully from node2 and node3
Stopped etcd on node3 to simulate member outage
Wrote 'duringoutage' key and read it back via node1/node2 with node3 down; verified 2-endpoint health true
Restarted etcd on node3; verified it retrieved 'duringoutage' key and raft applied index matched other members (fully caught up)
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, systemctl is-active etcd, key reads) on all 3 nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), each via backgrounded 'sudo reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node after reboot until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id per node
After each node's restart, verified etcd rejoined, endpoint health/status showed 3/3 healthy with matching raft applied index, and prior keys were present before moving to the next node

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: member list and endpoint status show all 3 members started, healthy, node1 as leader

evidence.requirement: Key written via one member readable from others
evidence.summary: 'benchkey' put via node1 endpoint, then successfully read via node2 and node3 endpoints

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: node3 etcd stopped; write+read of 'duringoutage' succeeded via node1/node2 with only 2/3 endpoints healthy

evidence.requirement: Returning member catches up to current data
evidence.summary: node3 etcd restarted, retrieved 'duringoutage' key it missed while down, raft applied index matched other members (16=16=16)

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id bccb87ac..., etcd active, both keys present on node1

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot ack returned before disconnect; new boot_id 9cfa8892... confirms actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery and quorum
evidence.summary: etcd active, all 3 endpoints healthy at matching raft index 24, keys intact, node2 elected new leader

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 45c22b1f..., etcd active, both keys present on node2

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot ack returned before disconnect; new boot_id c770111f... confirms actual restart

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery and quorum
evidence.summary: etcd active, all 3 endpoints healthy at matching raft index 29, keys intact, node3 elected leader

evidence.requirement: node3 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id fb2aa416..., etcd active, both keys present on node3

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot ack returned before disconnect; new boot_id fcdb2e89... confirms actual restart

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery and full cluster quorum (final state)
evidence.summary: etcd active, all 3 endpoints healthy at matching raft index 34, both keys intact, node1 leader, full 3/3 quorum restored
